## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Le Relecq-Kerhuon, France. It starts at Port de Plaisance du Moulin Blanc.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Océanopolis is a treat for anyone interested in the ocean, conversations about climate change, and just seeing oceanic animals roaming and swimming in large, open spaces!
>
> With 77 aquariums, an otter trail, Europe's biggest penguin habitat, and 1,000 animal species, this is the best way to explore the ocean without a submarine or scuba suit!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.58. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 187 ratings and 84 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
